annotations.title: Installment plan of an invoice or bill

description: The installment plan of one posted invoice or bill: what it still owed when the plan was set up (total), split into dated installments. How often (frequencyCode): WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, SEMIMONTHLY (twice a month, on semiMonthlyDays), MONTHLY, BIMONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMIANNUAL, YEARLY or CUSTOM (dates and amounts typed by the user). Each installment has its date, amount, what is paid of it, what is still open and its status: PAID, PARTLY_PAID, UPCOMING, DUE_TODAY or OVERDUE (daysPastDue). Payments of any kind count toward the oldest installments first. Also the next installment, what is due now, the plan's status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED) and how it is collected: an invoice by charging the client's card on file (CARD_ON_FILE), through its pay link (PAY_LINK) or by the business itself (MANUAL); a bill by an AUTOPAY the bank or supplier takes and the books record on each date (from paidFromCode or moneyAccountId), or by hand (MANUAL). reminders says the reminder days and whether the books' plan sends them (available=false with reasonCode PLAN_REQUIRED). plan is null when the document has none; canCreate and reasonCode then say whether one can be set up. This only reads: the user sets up, changes, pauses, resumes or cancels a plan, and asks the client for a card, in Mobile Accounting (openInApp).
